title: F-GC21 Restricted Predictor-Corrector Coupling Window Orchestrator Current-Canonical Admission
promotion_requirements: The F-CI56 admission workflow must pass on the exact final status head before promotion.
Immediately before promotion, integration/f-ci-canonical must still equal the restart canonical or F-CI56 must be recomposed and requalified.
Promotion must be a true two-parent merge with the then-live canonical as first parent and the exact final qualified F-CI56 head as second parent.
Force, squash and rebase promotion are forbidden.
Broad postpromotion canonical qualification including current-restricted-canonical-preservation must be green before closeout.
hard_nonclaims: No production direct-groundwater coupling admission by this workunit alone.
No MODFLOW adapter or aquifer-solver end-to-end qualification.
No crash-recovery or distributed transaction protocol qualification.
closeout_policy: After executable qualification, create at most one bounded status/audit closeout commit for promotion readiness. Once that exact head is green, freeze the qualification branch and do not add a self-referential metadata commit merely to record the later run.
